categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Haitian Ruisheng Science Technology Ltd. primarily engages in AI training data research, design, production, and sales. Its core business covers intelligent speech (speech recognition and synthesis), computer vision, and natural language processing, serving applications such as intelligent driving, human-computer interaction, content generation, smart home, smart city, and intelligent security. The company also provides standardized data products, customized training data services, and related application services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced AI algorithms including speech recognition (ASR), speech synthesis (TTS), computer vision, and natural language processing. It employs a comprehensive data production process involving dataset design, raw data collection, data annotation, and quality control. The firm has developed an integrated data processing platform with automated algorithms to enhance efficiency and quality. It also invests in multi-modal data, large model data services, and cutting-edge technologies like Chain of Thought (CoT) for complex reasoning tasks.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international technology giants such as Alibaba, Tencent, Baidu, iFlytek, Hikvision, ByteDance, Microsoft, Amazon, and Samsung, as well as research institutions like the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Tsinghua University. The company serves sectors including technology internet, social media, IoT, intelligent driving, large AI models, government, education, and research institutions. Its products support AI applications in personal assistants, speech input, content generation, smart devices, virtual humans, smart finance, and more.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant overseas business expansion. Its overseas revenue grew substantially, accounting for nearly half of total revenue, with operations and data collection activities in countries including the US, Germany, Spain, Czech Republic, Russia, Austria, Singapore, and others. It has established subsidiaries and data delivery bases in Singapore, the US, and Hong Kong to support global operations and supply chain.
categories.supply_chain_position: Haitian Ruisheng operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the AI data supply chain, focusing on the design, collection, processing, annotation, and delivery of high-quality training datasets. It integrates upstream raw data acquisition with downstream customized data services and product licensing, supported by a robust supply chain ecosystem including strategic suppliers and global data collection resources.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AI foundational algorithms, multi-modal data processing, large model data services, and intelligent driving data platforms. It invests heavily in algorithm upgrades, platform tool enhancements, and multi-language speech linguistic research. Strategic initiatives include expanding global market presence, developing Chain of Thought (CoT) datasets for complex reasoning, exploring embodied intelligence data, and strengthening data security and compliance frameworks. R&D expenditure accounted for 26.76% of revenue in 2024.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through three main streams: customized training data services charged as service fees without IP ownership transfer; standardized training data products sold via licensing with IP ownership retained by the company; and related application services including data processing tools, model training, evaluation, and software/hardware platform services, often delivered via software licensing or integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haitian Ruisheng is a leading domestic AI foundational data service provider and the only listed company in its sector on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Sci-Tech Innovation Board. It competes with international firms like Appen and domestic companies such as DataTang and Biaobei Technology. The company differentiates itself through its comprehensive integrated data platform, extensive standardized product portfolio, strong multi-language linguistic capabilities, and recognized data security compliance, maintaining a strong competitive position in China and growing presence internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 237 million, a 39.45% increase year-over-year, driven by rapid growth in large model technologies and expanding application scenarios. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 11.34 million, recovering from prior losses. Operating cash flow improved significantly to RMB 28.73 million. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 808 million with equity of RMB 743 million. R&D investment remained robust at over RMB 63 million, representing 26.76% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Haitian Ruisheng emphasizes high-quality, large-scale, and structured AI training data with proprietary intellectual property rights, enabling scalable and repeatable sales. Its unique value lies in comprehensive multi-modal data coverage, including over 205 languages/dialects and extensive phonetic dictionaries, supporting diverse AI applications globally. The company’s integrated data processing platform and algorithmic enhancements improve efficiency and data quality, while strict data security and compliance measures build customer trust. Its globalized service capabilities and strategic R&D investments position it as a reliable partner for AI model training and deployment.
